# A little intro
For Milestone 3, I have decided to perform some analysis on the Palmer Penguin dataset by Allison Horst: 

[Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

![Meet Palmer Penguins: allisonhorst.github.io](thepenguins.png)

# Exploring the penguins!

First, I am going to import the relevant libraries that we are going to be using in this analysis.
```{python}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
import pandas as pd
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib as plt
```

Next, let's get a glimpse of what the penguins dataset looks like.

```{python}
penguins = load_penguins()
penguins
```

The first thing I would like to do is find the average bill depths of each specie.

```{python}
arrange_penguins = (
    penguins.dropna(subset=["species", "bill_depth_mm"])
    .groupby("species")["bill_depth_mm"]
    .mean()
    .reset_index(name="mean_bill_depth")
    .sort_values(by="mean_bill_depth")
)
print(arrange_penguins)
```

Now, I'm going to plot it as a bar chart!

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-bill-by-species
#| fig-cap: "Bill Depth by species."
arrange_plot = sns.barplot(
    data=arrange_penguins, 
    x='species', 
    y='mean_bill_depth', 
    color='steelblue'
)

arrange_plot.set_title("Bill Depths by Specie")
```

I would also like to see the distribution of the penguins by bill depth and body mass because there may possibly be some sort of correlation. I'm also going to label them by specie.

```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass-bill-species
#| fig-cap: "Bill Depth by Body mass of penguins by species."

penguins = penguins.dropna()

p = sns.relplot(
    data=penguins,
    x='body_mass_g',
    y='bill_depth_mm',
    hue='species',
    kind='scatter',
    height=6,
    aspect=1.2
)

p.set_axis_labels('Body Mass (g)', 'Bill Depth (mm)')
p.fig.suptitle('Bill Depth vs Body Mass by Species', y=1.02)
p._legend.set_title('Species')

```

I can conclude that there is definitely a correlation between the body masses, bill depths and species of the penguins.
